text: | boundary_physical | manufacturing and FG gates | Use the same material state and time cut at every physical gate. Whole-stream manufacturing: Ow + F + Ru + O_air + X = Cw + G_Q + B + Wm + Em. FG: Of + G_Q + Rg = Cf + grossV + Wf. Ow/Cw include every source WIP and unreleased gate; F is first external whole-alloy feed; Ru/Rg are disjoint true returns to WIP/FG; B is actual companion casting; Wm/Wf and Em sum individually identified outgoing wastes/species once. X is only separately named additional mass not already on that same input side; never re-add F or assayed constituents. Combine gates by cancelling G_Q and all internal transfers. Q is normalization, never added again to Cf or grossV. Containers/mould stocks have their separate component gates; wear entering metal is a measured cross-ledger transfer. | ilcd-2010 |

| boundary_packaging | each actual component and physical gate | For each carton, pallet, polyethylene film, polypropylene band, whole supplied paper label and reusable steel container independently, measure all first external physical receipts: purchased P and non-purchased N_ext including supplier-supplied attached articles, first entrusted/borrowed/rented receipts. P remains purchase only. ER requires the same article/cohort previously dispatched externally; P/N_ext/ER are mutually exclusive. Opening stock never replaces a current receipt. Close O + P + N_ext + ER + F_in = C + grossS + EO + W + F_out on that same component/gate. F_in/F_out are independently measured and separately named actual material/water/species or phase-transfer legs crossing this component gate, excluding quantities already in P/N_ext/ER or grossS/EO/W. Include genuine retained contamination or moisture change only when observed; pair each internal cross-ledger transfer with its counterpart and cancel it only at the combined gate. Measure whole contaminated W once with non-additive component/content partitions and one provider. A real new retained-material input is not an OTHER duplicate: X can remove only an exactly duplicated term on the same side. No actual wet operation, reaction yield or quantity is defaulted. O/C include empty stock, attached WIP/FG and reusable stock; grossS is packaging on all physical outward consignments, never net Q. EO is a distinct external return. Internal stores/WIP/FG issues/reuse cancel. Each actual event requires the concrete material/form/type/direction card or interface and measured quantity; a missing interface makes the data package incomplete. A symbol alone, borrowed purchase UUID, invented purchase/return or wholesale duplication cannot repair it. | nt-britannia-2015; nt-white-metals; ilcd-2010 |

| val_packaging | all actual applicable records | Inspect each actual component event/interface and measured quantity, including supplier-attached nonpurchase/first entrusted/borrowed/rented receipts. P/N_ext/ER are disjoint and ER has prior external dispatch. In production, contract manufacture and services alike, verify O + P + N_ext + ER + F_in = C + grossS + EO + W + F_out on the same component/gate, including empty/WIP/FG/reusable stocks; internal use cancels. Missing real interfaces cannot pass through added symbols, fictitious receipts or duplicate batches. | nt-britannia-2015; ilcd-2010 |
